title: The TOSS 5 systemd-journald service must be enabled.
check_content:
Verify "systemd-journald" is active on TOSS 5 using the following command:

$ systemctl is-active systemd-journald

active

If the "systemd-journald" service is not active, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Enable the "systemd-journald" service using the following command:

$ sudo systemctl enable --now systemd-journald
VulnDiscussion: In the event of a system failure, TOSS 5 must preserve any information necessary to determine cause of the failure and return to operations with the least disruption to system processes.
